blurb: Guests can enjoy wines made from grapes grown on site, with all fermentation, processing, aging, and bottling done at the winery. The winery offers a variety of aromatic wines suited to the local microclimate. The vineyard was replanted in 2005 with varieties chosen for their suitability to the site.
extraNote: Prices exclude 15% GST/BC PST and an additional 10c bottle deposit per bottle will be charged.
